summary: Added DAV auth rate limiting (10 attempts/60s per client IP), CaldavMetrics failure-classification counters, and 11 adversarial tests covering throttling, oversized/malformed body rejection before writes, log redaction, production HTTPS enforcement, and metrics classification.
follow_up: Rate limiter is in-memory; a multi-instance deployment would need a shared store (e.g. Redis) for consistent throttling across replicas.
important_context: DAV_AUTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 and DAV_AUTH_WINDOW_SECONDS=60 are constants in caldav/auth.rs; tune via config if needed.
CaldavMetrics is Arc-shared and thread-safe; scrape via accounts.metrics() for operator monitoring.
authenticate_dav_request helper in http.rs is the single entry point for all DAV auth; rate limit is checked before any DB lookup.
